introHtml: When you need reliable timing for sports events, school races, or workplace safety drills, a custom Hanes stopwatch timer combines trusted brand quality with your logo. Hanes apparel is already a staple for uniforms and giveaways, but adding a stopwatch timer to your lineup gives recipients a functional tool they'll use daily. Choose from screen printing or embroidery on the timer itself or pair it with a Hanes T-shirt or hoodie for a coordinated promotional kit. Bulk orders keep costs low while maximizing brand visibility at every timed event.
